name: raycast-store-updates
title: Raycast Store Updates
description: Never miss new extensions or extension updates ever again!
author: chrismessina

preferences.name: trackReadStatus
preferences.title: Read Status
preferences.label: Enable read/unread statuses
preferences.description: Mark items as read and hide them from the list.

preferences.name: githubToken
preferences.title: GitHub Token
preferences.description: Optional. Raises the GitHub API limit from 60 to 5,000 requests/hour. A classic token with no scopes is enough.

preferences.name: useGraphQL
preferences.title: GraphQL
preferences.label: Use GraphQL (experimental)
preferences.description: Fetch pull requests via GraphQL. Requires a token; falls back to REST without one.

preferences.name: menuBarScope
preferences.title: Menu Bar
preferences.description: Which updates the menu bar counts. Does not affect the main list.

commands.name: view-store-updates
commands.title: View Store Updates
commands.subtitle: Raycast Store Updates
commands.description: See the latest Raycast store updates and new extensions

commands.name: store-updates-menu-bar
commands.title: Store Updates Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Raycast Store Updates
commands.description: Show new and updated Raycast Store extensions in the menu bar

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
